Mr. Market is currently pricing in a significant structural deceleration in Duolingo's monetization engine, reflecting deep skepticism about the company's ability to sustain its historical high-growth trajectory. At a valuation of 28.4x P/OE and 23.5x EV/OE, the market is grappling with a stark divergence: while daily active user growth remains robust following strategic pivots, bookings growth has sharply decelerated to roughly 8% YoY.
